_why: Carousel-only hook lines. The saved hooks for these comics give away how the story ends; a carousel exists to make people want to know. YouTube and the Gumroad store keep their own lines. Read by pipeline_lib/carousel_from_pdf.py.
princes-gate: Six gunmen took 26 hostages in London. For six days, the world watched.
the-green-bicycle: A young woman was shot dead on a country lane. The only clue: a man on a green bicycle.
the-phantom-dna: DNA from one woman linked 40+ crimes across Europe. Police hunted her for 16 years.
the-dome-job: Armed men crashed a digger into the Millennium Dome for £200M in diamonds.
the-perfect-take: Eleven men stole $2.775 million from Brink's in Boston.
collared: A pizza driver robbed a bank with a bomb locked around his neck. He said someone had forced it on him.
the-lufthansa-heist: $5.875 million stolen from JFK Airport. Then the crew started turning up dead.
the-watcher: They bought a $1.3M dream house. The letters started days later.
the-lost-steamer: A cargo ship vanished off Florida in 1925. Last seen crossing the Bermuda Triangle.
